model: Four integer nonnegative amplitudes, opposite pairs (0,2),(1,3). Transfer one unit from larger to smaller if difference >=2, otherwise hold. Conserves each pair sum, not squared amplitude activity proxy. Deadband avoids oscillation for odd pair sums.
invariant: Correct imbalance without erasing total amplitude; quantized odd pair sums require a one-unit residual.
limits: Synthetic discrete feedback, not physical dynamics.
Activity conservation means amplitude sum only; squared amplitude generally decreases.
No disturbance recovery or communication delay tested.
